findings.highlight: I never raised you to be such a coward!
findings.evidenceJa: お姉ちゃん、士郎をそんな軟弱者に育てた覚えはないわよー！
findings.governingReading: The instructor speaks in her comic “big sister” role while claiming she never raised Shirou to be spineless.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the mock-parental claim but removes the self-address that makes it exaggerated role play.

findings.highlight: run to the ending without dying.
findings.evidenceJa: 一度も死なずにエンディングまで突っ走っちゃいなさい。
findings.governingReading: The player is challenged to sprint all the way to the ending without dying even once.
findings.explanation: The English preserves survival but removes the explicit zero-death run.

findings.highlight: you won’t make it ahead unless you’re that determined!
findings.evidenceJa: それぐらいの漢気がないとやっていけないっす！
findings.governingReading: The apprentice says the coming stretch demands that degree of bold, conventionally manly spirit.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the dojo’s gendered martial-comic register to generic determination.

findings.evidenceJa: それでは諸君、健闘を祈る！
findings.governingReading: The instructor formally wishes all assembled listeners good fighting fortune.
findings.explanation: The English removes the plural audience address and weakens martial success into personal luck.
